title: Impact of Surprise Tariff Announcements on Industry Returns

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

The research question asks about the immediate impact of *surprise* tariff announcements on the cumulative abnormal returns (CAR) of industries exposed to international trade. This scenario is perfectly suited for an **Event Study** methodology.

**Why Event Study?**
An event study is designed to measure the impact of a specific event (the tariff announcement) on security prices. It achieves this by examining abnormal returns (returns not attributable to market-wide movements) around the event date. The core idea is that if the market is efficient, only unexpected information will lead to abnormal returns. By focusing on "surprise" announcements, we aim to isolate the causal effect of the new information.
